- **Collects transcripts** with `collect.sh`: copies all referenced transcripts to `captures/transcripts/`
- **Defines test runs**:
  1. Headless with two parallel subagents (bash command + README read)
  2. Interactive session ended with `/exit` (with permission prompt approval delay)
  3. Interactive session ended with Ctrl-C
- **PR #4 validates**: agent_id fields in tool calls, PPID/CLAUDE_PID matching, SessionEnd timing after exit/interrupt, payload sizes

Curated payloads go to `fixtures/claude-code/<version>/` after running `./collect.sh`.
